findings.quoted_text: The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due sixty (60) days following the Effective Date.

Subcontractor may, at its sole discretion, assist Manufacturer in the liquidation of any inventory that is generic that does not utilize any of Subcontractor's technology. findings.explanation: The second installment of the Technology Access Fee is due sixty days following the Effective Date, which delays payment beyond thirty days.
findings.suggested_change: The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due thirty (30) days following the first installment.

findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause, although you are guaranteed payment for product costs and cancellation charges.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon written notice to the other party, and the Client shall remain liable for all work completed and product costs incurred.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sending the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to request a minor update. - Regarding the timeline in the relevant clause, the second installment of the Technology Access Fee is due sixty days following the Effective Date, which delays payment. I propose changing this so that the first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due thirty (30) days following the first installment. Please let me know if you are okay with this change. Best regards,
